final: WITH g AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college WHERE college_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN s), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM g), k AS (SELECT r.cnt, r.ratio, a.avgc FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.cnt > a.avgc) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count_kept, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_kept, AVG(cnt - avgc) AS avg_excess_kept FROM k
